AI.result: 顶级系统在文章类页面上F1=0.93表现趋同，但在结构化页面上F1范围为0.41-0.84，差异显著，揭示了仅基于文章类页面的基准无法发现的盲区。
AI.conclusion: WCXB数据集及其评估揭示了现有网页内容提取基准的局限性，表明需要在更多样化的页面类型上评估提取系统，以发现其在实际应用中的不足。

title: ACL-Verbatim: hallucination-free question answering for research
summary: Academic researchers need efficient and reliable methods for collecting high-quality information from trusted sources, but modern tools for AI-assisted research still suffer from the tendency of Large Language Models (LLMs) to produce factually inaccurate or nonsensical output, commonly referred to as hallucinations. We apply the extractive question answering system VerbatimRAG to research papers in the ACL Anthology, directly mapping user queries to verbatim text spans in retrieved documents. We contribute a novel ground truth dataset for the task of mapping user queries to relevant text spans in research papers, and use it to train and evaluate a variety of extractive models. Human annotation is performed by NLP researchers and is based on synthetic user queries generated using a custom pipeline based on the ScIRGen methodology, paired with chunks of research papers retrieved by VerbatimRAG. On this benchmark, a 150M-parameter ModernBERT token classifier trained on silver supervision from our pipeline achieves the best word-level F1 (53.6), ahead of the strongest evaluated LLM extractor (48.7).

AI.tldr: 本文提出VerbatimRAG，一种应用于研究论文的抽取式问答系统，通过将用户查询直接映射到文献中的原文片段来避免LLM幻觉。作者构建了新的基准数据集，并训练了一个150M参数的ModernBERT模型，在词级F1得分（53.6）上优于最强LLM抽取器（48.7）。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助研究工具依赖LLM生成答案，但LLM常产生幻觉（生成事实错误或无意义的输出），学术研究者需要更可靠、高效的方法从可信来源获取高质量信息。
AI.method: 采用VerbatimRAG抽取式问答系统，将用户查询映射到检索文档中的原文片段；基于ScIRGen方法生成合成用户查询，由NLP研究者进行人工标注，构建新的基准数据集；训练了一个150M参数的ModernBERT词分类器。
AI.result: 150M参数的ModernBERT词分类器在词级F1上达到53.6，优于最强LLM抽取器的48.7。
AI.conclusion: 小规模专用抽取模型（ModernBERT）在准确映射查询到原文片段的任务上，优于大规模通用LLM，表明面向特定任务的专用模型在避免幻觉和提升可靠性方面更具优势。

title: Draw2Think: Harnessing Geometry Reasoning through Constraint Engine Interaction
summary: Vision-language models solve geometry problems with rising accuracy, yet their intermediate states remain latent and unverifiable: a relation expressed in textual reasoning or drawing code carries no guarantee that a constraint-satisfying configuration realizes it. We observe that existing externalization methods based on rendered pixels or one-shot scripts fail to provide exact, per-action geometric guarantees. Enforcing geometric relations by algebraic definition closes this gap: the workspace becomes a constraint-checked evolving canvas. We present Draw2Think, a framework that recasts geometric reasoning from latent spatial inference into agentic interaction with the GeoGebra constraint engine. In a Propose-Draw-Verify loop, Draw2Think externalizes hypotheses onto an executable canvas, measures exact geometric quantities, and feeds structured observations back to the model, so subsequent reasoning proceeds from checked canvas state grounded by the shared workspace. This externalization makes two properties separately auditable: model-level Construction Fidelity (whether the canvas realizes the intended configuration) and engine-level Measurement Faithfulness (exact values and relations from canvas constraints). Across construction, outcome, and rendering evaluations, Draw2Think builds canvases that pass 95.9% predicate-level and 84.0% strict problem-level construction checks on GeoGoal, improves outcome accuracy by up to 4.1%/16.4% on planar/solid benchmarks, and attains 68.2%/90.5% strict/relaxed rendering scores on GenExam-math. Project page is available at https://draw2think.github.io/

AI.tldr: Draw2Think是一个将几何推理从潜在空间推断重构为与GeoGebra约束引擎交互式代理的框架。通过“提议-绘制-验证”循环，它外化假设到可执行画布上，测量精确几何量，并将结构化观察反馈给模型。实验表明，该方法在几何构建、结果准确性和渲染评估上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型解决几何问题时，其中间状态是潜在且不可验证的：无论是文本推理还是绘图代码，都无法保证其表达的关系能被一个满足约束的配置所实现。现有基于渲染像素或一次性脚本的外化方法无法提供精确的、逐动作的几何保证。
AI.method: 提出Draw2Think框架，通过代数定义强制执行几何关系，将工作空间变为约束检查的演化画布。采用Propose-Draw-Verify循环：模型提出假设，GeoGebra约束引擎执行绘制，测量精确几何量，将结构化观察反馈给模型，后续推理基于已检查的画布状态进行。
AI.result: 在GeoGoal上通过95.9%的谓词级和84.0%的严格问题级构建检查；在平面/立体基准上结果准确率提升高达4.1%/16.4%；在GenExam-math上获得68.2%/90.5%的严格/宽松渲染分数。
AI.conclusion: Draw2Think通过引入约束引擎实现可审计的几何推理外化，分别审计模型级构建保真度和引擎级测量忠实度，显著提升了几何问题求解的可靠性和准确性。

title: Smarter edits? Post-editing with error highlights and translation suggestions
summary: As MT quality increases, interest in enhanced post-editing features such as QE-derived error highlights is growing, yet evidence for their usefulness remains limited. In this work, we explore the usefulness of LLM-derived error highlights and correction suggestions based on automatic post-editing (APE). We conduct a study where professional translators (En-Nl) post-edit translations using APE error highlights and correction suggestions and compare productivity, quality and user experience to regular PE and PE with QE-derived highlights. While no condition yielded productivity or quality gains compared to regular PE, APE highlights were better received than QE-derived highlights, and correction suggestions improved overall user experience.

AI.tldr: 研究探索了基于大语言模型的自动译后编辑（APE）错误高亮和修正建议在专业翻译中的效果，虽未显著提升效率和质量，但用户接受度和体验优于传统质量估计方法。
AI.motivation: 随着机器翻译质量提升，增强型译后编辑功能（如质量估计驱动的错误高亮）需求增加，但其实际效用缺乏充分证据。
AI.method: 以专业译者（英译荷）为对象，比较三种译后编辑模式：常规译后编辑、基于质量估计（QE）的错误高亮、以及基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动译后编辑（APE）错误高亮与修正建议。
AI.result: 与常规译后编辑相比，两种增强模式均未在生产力或质量上带来显著提升；但APE高亮比QE高亮更受译者欢迎，修正建议改善了整体用户体验。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的APE错误高亮和修正建议尽管未提升客观效率，但在用户主观接受度和体验方面优于传统QE方法，具有进一步优化的潜力。

title: Diffuse to Detect: Bi-Level Sample Rebalancing with Pseudo-Label Diffusion for Point-Supervised Infrared Small-Target Detection
summary: Point supervision has become a scalable solution to address dense annotation for infrared small target detection, but its performance is limited by two coupled bottlenecks: unstable pseudo-label evolution in cluttered, low-contrast infrared imagery and severe sample-distribution imbalance. In this paper, we present a more adaptive and stable framework to address these issues. Leveraging the intrinsic consistency between thermal radiation patterns and heat diffusion, we propose a physics-induced annotation strategy that expands single-point labels into reliable pseudo-masks. To further enhance supervision and alleviate sample imbalance, we develop a bi-level dual-update framework that jointly optimizes detector weights, sample weights, and diffusion parameters. A meta-classifier dynamically predicts sample-wise loss weights, while a differentiable diffusion module refines pseudo-labels with detection feedback, enabling adaptive interaction between training and hyperparameter optimization. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate five-fold annotation acceleration, superior detection accuracy, and comparable performance with 30% of the training data, validating the efficiency and practicality of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/yuanhang-yao/diffuse-to-detect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于物理诱导的弱监督红外小目标检测框架，通过热扩散原理将单点标注扩展为伪掩码，并设计双层双更新机制联合优化检测器权重、样本权重和扩散参数，实现30%训练数据即可达到可比性能，标注速度提升5倍。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测中，点监督面临两个耦合瓶颈：低对比度、杂波场景下的伪标签演化不稳定，以及严重的样本分布不平衡问题。
AI.method: 1) 物理诱导标注策略：利用热辐射与热扩散的内在一致性，将单点标签扩展为可靠伪掩码；2) 双层双更新框架：联合优化检测器权重、样本权重和扩散参数；3) 元分类器动态预测样本损失权重，可微扩散模块利用检测反馈优化伪标签。
AI.result: 多数据集实验表明：标注速度提升5倍，检测精度更优，仅用30%训练数据即可达到与全监督可比性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了点监督在红外小目标检测中的伪标签不稳定和样本不平衡问题，验证了方法的效率与实用性。

title: Metaphors in Literary Post-Editing: Opening Pandora's Box?
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the EAMT Conference 2026, which will take place in Tilburg from June 15 to 18, 2026
summary: This paper investigates how post-editors of literary texts react and respond to the way metaphors have been translated by Neu ral Machine Translation (NMT) and Large Language Models (LLMs). The results show that one in three metaphors in the output were changed by the post-editors, demonstrating that the translation of fig urative language is indeed problematic in literary MT (LitMT). The responses indi cate that the post-editors were aware of overly literal translations, though mostly for multiword expressions. Moreover, at times they found it difficult to determine whether solutions were acceptable. They rated the overall quality of the MT out put as quite poor and stated that the post editing was more work and more effort than it would have been translating from scratch. This supports previous studies ar guing that post-editing constrains transla tors in their creativity and diminishes their sense of text ownership.

AI.tldr: 本文研究文学文本译后编辑对神经机器翻译（NMT）和大语言模型（LLM）所译隐喻的反应与修改。结果显示，三分之一的隐喻输出被译后编辑修改，表明文学机器翻译中比喻性语言翻译确实存在问题。译后编辑认为机器翻译质量较差，且译后编辑比从头翻译更费时费力，支持了译后编辑会限制译者创造力并削弱文本归属感的观点。
AI.motivation: 探究文学文本译后编辑如何评估和修改NMT及LLM对隐喻的翻译，验证比喻性语言在文学机器翻译中是否仍然是个难题。
AI.method: 通过实验让译后编辑对NMT和LLM输出的文学隐喻翻译进行编辑，收集编辑结果和主观反馈。
AI.result: 三分之一隐喻被修改；译后编辑注意到过于直译的问题（尤其是多词表达），有时难以判断解决方案是否可接受；MT输出整体质量评分较低；译后编辑认为比从零翻译更费力。
AI.conclusion: 支持已有研究：译后编辑会限制译者的创造力、削弱文本归属感；文学机器翻译中隐喻翻译仍存在问题，译后编辑并非更高效的选择。

title: AttriStory: Fine-grained Attribute Realization for Visual Storytelling with Diffusion Models
summary: Visual storytelling with diffusion models has made impressive strides in maintaining character consistency across narrative scenes. However, a critical gap remains: while these methods ensure a character remains consistent across scenes, they provide no systematic method to ensure if fine-grained attributes such as color and textures of clothing, accessories are faithfully rendered in the generated images. Towards this goal, we introduce AttriStory, a benchmark enabling attribute realization in visual storytelling. We curate 200 multi-scene stories across 10 distinct artistic styles using Large Language Model. Each scene is constructed with detailed attribute specifications to enable rich visual narratives. Further, to address attribute realization, we propose a plug-and-play latent optimization module that operates during early denoising steps, when the model establishes structural and semantic content. We achieve this through AttriLoss objective designed to maximize alignment between the cross-attention maps for desired attribute-object pairs while suppressing spurious associations, guiding models to localize attributes correctly. This approach operates orthogonally to existing consistency mechanisms, integrating seamlessly with current story generation pipelines without requiring architectural modifications. Our experiments demonstrate consistent improvements on incorporating AttriLoss across all baselines. This work positions attribute realization as a distinct, complementary dimension of visual storytelling, alongside character consistency, advancing the field toward fine-grained attribute-controlled story generation. Project-page:https://manogna-s.github.io/attristory/

AI.tldr: AttriStory是一个面向视觉故事讲述中属性实现（如服装颜色、纹理等细粒度属性）的基准测试，并提出了一种名为AttriLoss的即插即用潜在优化模块，通过早期去噪步骤中的交叉注意力图对齐来确保属性被准确渲染，无需修改现有模型架构。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在视觉故事讲述中虽能保持角色一致性，但缺乏系统方法确保细粒度属性（如服装颜色、纹理、配饰）在生成图像中被忠实呈现。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含200个多场景故事、10种艺术风格的AttriStory基准数据集；2) 提出AttriLoss优化目标，在早期去噪步骤中最大化期望属性-对象对的交叉注意力图对齐，同时抑制虚假关联；3) 该模块为即插即用设计，无需架构修改。
AI.result: 在多个基线模型上，引入AttriLoss均带来一致性的性能提升，有效改善了属性实现的准确性。
AI.conclusion: AttriStory将属性实现定位为视觉故事讲述中与角色一致性互补的独立维度，推动了细粒度属性可控故事生成的发展。

title: Do LLMs Know What Luxembourgish Borrows? Probing Lexical Neology in Low-Resource Multilingual Models
comment: Accepted to Neollm colocated with LREC2026, Three figures and three tables
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for writing assistance in small contact languages, yet it is unclear whether they respect community norms around lexical borrowing and neology. We introduce LexNeo-Bench, a 3{,}050-instance token-level benchmark derived from LuxBorrow, a large-scale Luxembourgish news corpus, where target tokens are labelled as native or as French, German, or English borrowings. Using this benchmark, we probe three multilingual LLMs across 34 prompt settings on two tasks: borrowing type classification and a binary lexical-innovation proxy (borrowing versus native). Without external context, models perform only slightly above chance on borrowing classification, so we construct a linguistic knowledge graph that encodes donor language, morphological patterns, and lexical analogues, and inject instance-specific subgraphs into the prompt. Knowledge-graph prompts raise borrowing classification accuracy from 25 -- 35\% up to 71 -- 81\% and largely close the gap between small and large models, while leaving neology detection difficult and sensitive to few-shot design. Our results show that lexicon-aware prompting is highly beneficial for robust borrowing judgments in low-resource contact languages and that lexical resources can serve as structured context for LLM evaluation. This study was carried out within the ENEOLI COST Action and examines borrowing as a form of lexical innovation in multilingual Luxembourgish data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LexNeo-Bench基准数据集，通过构建语言学知识图谱注入提示，将借贷词分类准确率从25-35%提升至71-81%，显示词汇感知提示对低资源接触语言的词汇创新检测有效。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于小接触语言的写作辅助，但尚不清楚它们是否尊重这些语言中关于词汇借用和新词创造的社区规范，因此需要评估LLM在低资源接触语言中的词汇借用判断能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含3,050个实例的LexNeo-Bench基准数据集（源自卢森堡语新闻语料库LuxBorrow），对34种提示设置下的三个多语言LLM进行两类任务评估：借用类型分类和二元词汇创新代理判断。通过构建语言学知识图（编码源语言、形态模式、词汇类比）并注入实例特定的子图到提示中提升性能。
AI.result: 无外部上下文时模型表现仅略高于随机水平；知识图提示将借贷分类准确率从25-35%提升至71-81%，基本消除了小型与大型模型之间的差距，但新词检测仍然困难且对少样本设计敏感。
AI.conclusion: 词汇感知提示对低资源接触语言中的稳健借贷判断非常有益，词汇资源可以作为结构化上下文用于LLM评估。

title: Findings of the Counter Turing Test: AI-Generated Image Detection
summary:
The rapid advancements in generative AI technologies, such as Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, and Midjourney, have significantly transformed the creation of synthetic visual content. While these models enable innovation across industries, they also pose serious challenges, including misinformation, disinformation, and biased content generation. The increasing realism of AI-generated images makes their detection a pressing concern for researchers, policymakers, and industry stakeholders.
  In this paper, we present the findings of the Defactify 4.0 workshop, which introduced the Counter Turing Test (CT2) for AI-Generated Image Detection. The competition consisted of two key tasks: (1) binary classification of images as either AI-generated or real and (2) identification of the specific generative model responsible for an AI-generated image. To facilitate this, we developed the MS COCOAI dataset, consisting of 50,000 synthetic images from multiple generative models alongside real-world images from the MS COCO dataset.
  Participants employed diverse detection strategies, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), frequency-based analysis, contrastive learning, and multimodal techniques. The results demonstrated that while AI-generated images can be detected with high accuracy (F1-score > 0.83), identifying the exact model used remains significantly more challenging (highest F1-score: 0.4986). These findings highlight the need for improved model fingerprinting, adversarial robustness, and real-time detection mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Defactify 4.0研讨会引入的逆向图灵测试（CT2）来检测AI生成图像，发现二分类检测能达到较高准确率（F1>0.83），但识别具体生成模型则困难得多（最高F1仅0.4986）。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI（如Stable Diffusion、DALL-E、Midjourney）的快速发展带来了 misinformation、disinformation 和有偏内容生成等严重挑战，因此迫切需要有效的AI生成图像检测方法。
AI.method: 通过Defactify 4.0研讨会设计逆向图灵测试（CT2），包含两个任务：① 图像的二分类（AI生成 vs 真实）；② 识别具体的生成模型。构建了包含50,000张合成图像（来自多种生成模型）和真实图像的MS COCOAI数据集，参与者使用CNN、ViT、频域分析、对比学习、多模态等多种方法进行检测。
AI.result: 二分类任务中F1分数超过0.83，表现良好；但识别具体生成模型任务中最高F1仅0.4986，准确率显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI图像检测在区分真假方面效果不错，但识别具体模型来源仍极具挑战，未来需要改进模型指纹识别、对抗鲁棒性和实时检测机制。

title: LamPO: A Lambda Style Policy Optimization for Reasoning Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective paradigm for improving reasoning language models on tasks such as mathematics, coding, and scientific question answering. However, widely used group-relative objectives, such as GRPO, summarize each sampled group with scalar statistics and therefore discard fine-grained relational information among candidate responses. This weakens credit assignment under sparse outcome rewards, especially when multiple generated solutions differ only subtly in reasoning quality. We propose \textbf{LamPO}, a \textbf{Lambda-Style Policy Optimization} method that replaces scalar group advantages with a \emph{Pairwise Decomposed Advantage}. LamPO aggregates pairwise reward gaps within each response group and modulates each comparison by a confidence-aware weight computed from sequence log-probability differences, while retaining the critic-free and clipped-update structure of PPO-style optimization. When reference solutions are available, we further add a lightweight ROUGE-L-based dense auxiliary reward to reduce reward sparsity. Experiments on AIME24, AIME25, MATH-500, and GPQA-Diamond with Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Phi-4-mini show that LamPO consistently improves over GRPO and recent RLVR variants, with more stable training dynamics and better sample efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出LamPO方法，通过成对分解优势函数和置信加权机制替代GRPO中的标量组优势，结合ROUGE-L密集奖励，在多个数学和科学推理任务上显著优于GRPO等基线方法。
AI.motivation: GRPO等组相对目标函数用标量统计量概括每组采样，丢失了候选响应间的细粒度关系信息，导致稀疏结果奖励下的信用分配薄弱，尤其当多个生成解仅在推理质量上有细微差异时。
AI.method: 提出LamPO（Lambda风格策略优化），用成对分解优势函数替代标量组优势；聚合组内成对奖励差异，并通过序列对数概率差异计算置信感知权重进行调制；保留无评论家网络和裁剪更新的PPO风格结构；在有参考解时引入基于ROUGE-L的轻量级密集辅助奖励以减少奖励稀疏性。
AI.result: 在AIME24、AIME25、MATH-500和GPQA-Diamond上，使用Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B和Phi-4-mini模型，LamPO一致优于GRPO及近期RLVR变体，训练动态更稳定，样本效率更高。
AI.conclusion: LamPO通过细粒度的成对比较和置信加权有效改善了稀疏奖励下的信用分配，提升了推理语言模型的训练效果和样本效率。

title: What Semantics Survive the Connector? Diagnosing VLM-to-DiT Alignment in Video Editing
summary: Flow matching based video generative models have been increasingly relying on prepended Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to handle complex, instruction-based video editing. The prevailing assumption underlying this paradigm is that a connector module can seamlessly align the VLM's rich multi-modal reasoning with the original text embedding space of DiTs. However, we hypothesize that this alignment acts as a severe semantic bottleneck, degrading fine-grained structural variables. Verifying this is challenging, as end-to-end evaluations conflate alignment failures with generation errors, and natural datasets lack disentangled annotations. To rigorously investigate this, we propose a controlled data processing pipeline based on video composition that results in TRACE-Edit, a diagnostic dataset focusing on relation-based editing. Leveraging this dataset, we propose a comprehensive diagnostic protocol to analyze two important designs of meta-query and connector in the existing video editing models. Systematic evaluation of four representative model cases reveals that fine-grained structural semantics can be severely degraded during alignment. Our findings overturn the assumption of lossless semantic transfer, identifying the VLM-to-DiT alignment as a major bottleneck and providing a new diagnostic foundation for future multi-modal alignment architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文发现基于Flow Matching的视频生成模型中，VLM与DiT之间的语义对齐存在严重的信息瓶颈，会显著退化细粒度的结构语义。作者通过构建TRACE-Edit诊断数据集和系统评估方法，验证了这一假设，颠覆了“无损语义迁移”的既有认知。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设连接器模块能够无缝地将VLM的多模态推理对齐到DiT的文本嵌入空间，但作者怀疑这种对齐实际上是一个语义瓶颈，会退化细粒度的结构变量。然而端到端评估难以区分对齐失败和生成错误，且自然数据集缺乏解耦标注，因此需要严格的研究方法。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于视频合成的受控数据处理流程，构建TRACE-Edit诊断数据集，聚焦关系编辑任务；2) 设计全面的诊断协议，分析现有视频编辑模型中meta-query和connector两种关键设计；3) 对四个代表性模型案例进行系统评估。
AI.result: 细粒度的结构语义在VLM到DiT的对齐过程中会严重退化，识别出该对齐环节是视频编辑模型的主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 颠覆了“无损语义迁移”的既有假设，指出VLM到DiT的对齐是主要瓶颈，为未来多模态对齐架构提供了新的诊断基础。

title: OlmoEarth v1.1: A more efficient family of OlmoEarth models
summary: We present a set of improvements to the OlmoEarth family. These improvements allow us to cut compute costs during training ($1.7 \times$ reduction in GPU hours required to train our Base models) and inference ($2.9\times$ reductions in MACs on Sentinel-2 tasks), while maintaining the models' overall performance. All training code is available at github.com/allenai/olmoearth_pretrain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了对OlmoEarth系列的改进，在保持模型整体性能的同时，将训练GPU小时数减少1.7倍，Sentinel-2任务的推理MACs减少2.9倍。
AI.motivation: 降低OlmoEarth系列模型在训练和推理阶段的计算成本，同时保持模型性能。
AI.method: 对OlmoEarth系列模型进行了一系列改进，具体改进细节未在摘要中详述。
AI.result: 训练GPU小时数减少1.7倍，Sentinel-2任务推理MACs减少2.9倍，模型整体性能保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 提出的改进方法能有效降低计算成本，且不影响模型性能。

title: Tracing the ongoing emergence of human-like reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Humans effortlessly go beyond literal meanings: If you mow the lawn, I will give you fifty dollars, is typically understood as implying that the speaker will pay only if the lawn is mowed, whereas If you are hungry, there is pizza in the oven implies that pizza is available regardless of the hearers hunger. Large Language Models - LLMs - show human-like performance on many tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they reason like humans. To address this, we conducted a population-matching experiment assessing how twentyfive LLMs compute conditional inferences across four languages, compared to an equal number of humans per language. We find that humans enrich logical reasoning through pragmatic inferences across languages. Model behavior is more variable. Some LLMs perfectly follow the truth-table of conditionals but they ignore pragmatic inferences, while others deviate from the truth-table, adhering to a single interpretation across the board, thus reflecting accurate rule-based processing but not human-like reasoning. Overall, LLMs are accurate semantic operators, but fail to capture the pragmatic enrichments characteristic of human reasoning. Crucially, LLM accuracy is neither predicted nor boosted by open vs. closed status, training orientation, or architecture type, suggesting that pragmatic reasoning is still an emerging ability in the cognitive toolkit of artificial systems.

AI.tldr: LLMs在条件推理中表现出准确的语义处理能力，但缺乏人类特有的语用推理能力，且模型行为比人类更具变异性。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型（LLMs）是否像人类一样进行语用推理，超越字面意义理解条件句。
AI.method: 对25个LLM和25个人类（每种语言）进行跨四语言的种群匹配实验，评估条件推理能力。
AI.result: 人类跨语言表现出语用推理；LLM行为更不稳定，有的完全遵循真值表但忽略语用，有的偏离真值表坚持单一解释。模型准确性与开放/封闭、训练方向、架构类型无关。
AI.conclusion: LLMs是精准的语义操作者，但未能捕捉人类推理中的语用丰富性，语用推理在人工系统中仍是新兴能力。

title: Decomposing Subject-Driven Image Generation via Intermediate Structural Prediction
summary: Subject-driven text-to-image generation still struggles to preserve high-frequency identity details such as logos, patterns, and text. Existing methods typically operate directly in RGB space, which often leads to detail degradation under substantial edits. We propose a two-stage framework that decouples structure from appearance by first predicting a Canny map and then rendering the final image conditioned on both the source appearance and the predicted structure. To improve text handling, we further introduce a fully automatic pipeline that constructs a 100k-pair text-aware dataset with cross-view textual consistency. Experiments, including GPT-4.1-based evaluation and a knowledge distillation study, show clear gains over selected baselines and suggest that intermediate structural prediction is an effective route for high-fidelity subject-driven generation. Our dataset and code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架，先预测Canny边缘图再生成图像，结合文本感知数据集，实现高保真主体驱动的文本到图像生成。
AI.motivation: 现有主体驱动文本到图像生成方法在保留高频身份细节（如标志、图案、文字）方面仍存在困难，RGB空间直接操作导致细节退化。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段预测Canny边缘图解耦结构与外观，第二阶段基于源外观和预测结构渲染图像；同时构建100k对文本感知数据集保证跨视角文本一致性。
AI.result: GPT-4.1评估和知识蒸馏实验表明，该方法在保真度上优于所选基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 中间结构预测是实现高保真主体驱动生成的有效途径，数据集和代码将公开。

title: TextReg: Mitigating Prompt Distributional Overfitting via Regularized Text-Space Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to the prompts used to specify task objectives and behavioral constraints. Many recent prompt optimization methods iteratively rewrite prompts using LLM-generated feedback, but the resulting prompts often become longer, accumulate narrow sample-specific rules, and generalize poorly beyond the training distribution. We study this failure mode as prompt distributional overfitting and argue that it reflects a lack of representation control in discrete text-space optimization. We formalize this view through representational inefficiency, a dual-factor measure that decomposes prompt inefficiency into capacity cost and scope narrowness, attributing distributional prompt overfitting to their coupled growth during optimization. We propose TextReg, a regularization framework that realizes a soft-penalty objective through regularized textual gradients, combining Dual-Evidence Gradient Purification, Semantic Edit Regularization, and Regularization-Guided Prompt Update. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, TextReg substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, with accuracy gains of up to +11.8% over TextGrad and +16.5% over REVOLVE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TextReg正则化框架，通过在离散文本空间中施加表示控制，有效缓解了提示优化中的分布过拟合问题，在多个推理基准上实现OOD泛化提升高达+16.5%。
AI.motivation: LLM对提示高度敏感，现有提示优化方法在迭代重写过程中容易产生过拟合：提示变长、积累样本特定规则、在训练分布外泛化差。作者将这种失败模式归因为提示分布过拟合，并指出其根源是离散文本空间优化中缺乏表示控制。
AI.method: 提出TextReg正则化框架：1) 提出表征低效性（representational inefficiency）双因子度量，分解为容量代价和范围狭窄性；2) 通过正则化文本梯度实现软惩罚目标，包含双证据梯度净化、语义编辑正则化和正则化引导提示更新三个组件。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上，TextReg显著提升OOD泛化性能，相比TextGrad准确率最高提升+11.8%，相比REVOLVE最高提升+16.5%。
AI.conclusion: 提示分布过拟合源于表征低效性中容量代价与范围狭窄性的耦合增长，通过TextReg的表示控制正则化可以有效缓解该问题，提升提示的OOD泛化能力。

title: Spatial Gram Alignment for Ultra-High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary: Modern ultra-high-resolution image synthesis relies heavily on the robust generative capacity of large-scale pre-trained Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs). While recent representation alignment methods have proven effective by distilling visual priors from foundation models (e.g., SAM or DINO) into generative latent features, scaling these approaches to pre-trained LDMs at extreme resolutions exposes a critical learnability-fidelity conflict. Specifically, forcing direct patch-wise feature distillation inherently perturbs the pre-trained latent manifold, ultimately leading to generation degradation. To address this bottleneck, we propose Spatial Gram Alignment (SGA), a novel framework that explicitly leverages the representation priors of vision foundation models while preserving the native generative capacity of LDMs. Moving beyond restrictive direct alignment, SGA imposes a non-invasive spatial constraint by aligning the internal self-similarities of the generative features with those of the foundation priors. This spatial constraint effectively establishes macroscopic structural coherence, while the native generative objectives retain the microscopic pixel-level fidelity inherent to the original LDMs. Notably, this versatile strategy integrates seamlessly across both intermediate diffusion features and VAE latents within pre-trained LDMs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SGA achieves state-of-the-art performance for ultra-high-resolution text-to-image synthesis, yielding an effective reconciliation between global structural integrity and fine-grained visual details. Code is available at https://github.com/zhang0jhon/SGA.

AI.tldr: 针对超高分辨率图像合成中，现有表示对齐方法在预训练潜扩散模型（LDM）上存在可学习性与保真度冲突的问题，提出空间克对齐（SGA）框架，通过约束生成特征与基础模型先验的内部自相似性，在不干扰预训练潜空间的前提下实现全局结构一致性与局部像素保真度的平衡，在超高分文本到图像合成任务上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表示对齐方法在将基础模型（如SAM、DINO）的视觉先验蒸馏到生成潜特征时，若强行进行逐块特征对齐，会破坏预训练LDM的潜流形，导致生成质量下降，存在可学习性与保真度之间的根本冲突。
AI.method: 提出空间克对齐（Spatial Gram Alignment, SGA）框架：不对齐特征本身，而是对齐生成特征与基础模型先验的内部自相似性（空间Gram矩阵），从而施加非侵入式的空间约束，保留原生生成目标以保证像素级保真度，可同时应用于扩散中间特征和VAE潜变量。
AI.result: 在超高分辨率文本到图像合成任务上达到SOTA性能，有效实现了全局结构完整性与细粒度视觉细节之间的调和。
AI.conclusion: SGA通过空间自相似性对齐替代直接特征对齐，为解决超高分辨率生成中的结构-保真度冲突提供了一条有效路径，且具有较好的通用性。

title: SymbolicLight V1: Spike-Gated Dual-Path Language Modeling with High Activation Sparsity and Sub-Billion-Scale Pre-Training Evidence
comment: 35 pages, 5 figures, 25 tables; public code and model artifacts linked in manuscript
summary:
Natively trained spiking language models struggle to combine Transformer-like language quality, stable multi-domain pre-training, and high activation sparsity. We present SymbolicLight V1, a spike-gated dual-path language model that combines binary Leaky Integrate-and-Fire spike dynamics with a continuous residual stream. Its Dual-Path SparseTCAM module replaces dense self-attention with an exponential-decay aggregation path for long-range memory and a spike-gated local attention path for short-range precision, complemented by a dynamic context-conditioned decoding head and a bilingual tokenizer.
  A 194M-parameter SymbolicLight V1 model trained from scratch on a 3B-token Chinese-English corpus reaches held-out validation PPL 8.88-8.93 across four independent runs at >89% per-element activation sparsity. It trails GPT-2 201M by 7.7% in PPL while surpassing GPT-2 124M under the reported comparison. Component ablations at matched 0.5B-token training budgets show that the spike-gated local attention path is the largest contributor, and that replacing LIF dynamics with a deterministic top-k mask at matched sparsity causes a larger degradation, indicating that temporal integration rather than sparsity alone drives performance. We also report a 0.8B-parameter scale-up run trained on 48.8B tokens as evidence of optimization and sparsity preservation, not as a primary quality comparison. Current dense-hardware inference is slower than GPT-2, so neuromorphic deployment is presented as a future sparsity-driven opportunity rather than an achieved hardware speedup.

AI.tldr: SymbolicLight V1是一种尖峰门控双路径语言模型，在3B tokens中英文语料上训练，以>89%激活稀疏性达到PPL 8.88-8.93，性能介于GPT-2 124M和201M之间，但当前在密集硬件上推理速度较慢。
AI.motivation: 原生训练的尖峰语言模型难以同时实现类似Transformer的语言质量、稳定的多领域预训练和高激活稀疏性，作者希望设计一种能兼顾三者的新架构。
AI.method: 提出SymbolicLight V1，核心是Dual-Path SparseTCAM模块，包含指数衰减聚合路径（长程记忆）和尖峰门控局部注意力路径（短程精度），结合二元LIF尖峰动力学、连续残差流、动态解码头及双语分词器。
AI.result: 194M参数模型在3B tokens上训练，PPL 8.88-8.93，激活稀疏性>89%。性能优于GPT-2 124M，比GPT-2 201M差7.7%。消融实验表明尖峰门控局部注意力贡献最大，LIF动力学优于同等稀疏度的确定性top-k掩码。0.8B参数在48.8B tokens上进一步验证了优化和稀疏保持。
AI.conclusion: SymbolicLight V1在语言质量与稀疏性之间实现了有效权衡，但当前在密集硬件上推理慢于GPT-2，未来需通过神经形态硬件发挥其稀疏性优势。

title: OSGNet with MLLM Reranking @ Ego4D Episodic Memory Challenge 2026
comment: Champion solution for the Natural Language Queries and GoalStep tracks of the Ego4D Challenge at the CVPR EgoVis Workshop 2026
summary: In this report, we present our champion solutions for the Natural Language Queries and GoalStep tracks of the Ego4D Episodic Memory Challenge at CVPR 2026. Both tracks require accurately localizing temporal segments from long untrimmed egocentric videos. To address these tasks, we propose a reranking-based framework that effectively leverages the strong video-language reasoning capability of multimodal large language model (MLLM) while preserving the efficiency and candidate recall of conventional localization pipelines. Specifically, we first obtain a set of candidate segments from existing localization model OSGNet, and then employ MLLM to select the segment that best matches the given query, thereby refining the final prediction. Ultimately, our method achieved first place in both the Natural Language Queries and GoalStep tracks. Our code can be found at https://github.com/iLearn-Lab/CVPR25-OSGNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于重排序的框架，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）增强候选片段的选择能力，在Ego4D情景记忆挑战的两个赛道中均获得第一名。
AI.motivation: 现有定位流水线虽然高效且召回率高，但在精细的视频-语言推理方面存在不足，而MLLM虽然推理能力强但直接处理长视频效率低下，因此需要一种结合两者优势的方法。
AI.method: 首先使用现有定位模型OSGNet生成一组候选片段，然后利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对这些候选片段进行重排序，选择与查询最匹配的片段作为最终预测结果。
AI.result: 该方法在Ego4D情景记忆挑战的Natural Language Queries和GoalStep两个赛道中均取得了第一名。
AI.conclusion: 提出的重排序框架能有效平衡效率和准确性，通过结合传统定位模型的候选生成能力和MLLM的精细推理能力，显著提升了在长视频中定位目标片段的表现。

title: AIR: Amortized Image Reconstruction Framework for Self-Supervised Feed-Forward 2D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 2D Gaussian splatting provides an efficient explicit representation for image reconstruction, but existing methods still require costly per-image iterative optimization or rely on handcrafted priors for primitive allocation. We present AIR, a self-supervised feed-forward framework that amortizes iterative Gaussian fitting into a single network pass, eliminating per-image test-time optimization. AIR adopts a stage-wise residual architecture that progressively predicts additional Gaussian primitives from reconstruction residuals, together with an explicit Stage Control mechanism that activates new primitives only in under-reconstructed regions. A Predict--Optimize--Distill training strategy stabilizes multi-stage prediction by distilling short-horizon optimized Gaussian increments back into the predictor. The stabilized predictor is then jointly finetuned across stages and equipped with an image-adaptive quantizer for compact Gaussian storage. Experiments on Kodak and DIV2K show that AIR achieves better reconstruction quality than representative Gaussian-based baselines while reducing encoding time to 160--300\,ms. Code: https://github.com/whoiszzj/AIR.git

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIR，一种自监督前馈框架，通过单次网络前向传播将迭代高斯拟合摊销化，无需逐图像测试时优化，采用逐阶段残差架构和显式阶段控制机制，在欠重构区域逐步添加高斯基元，配合预测-优化-蒸馏训练策略稳定多阶段预测，最终实现优于现有高斯基线方法的重建质量，同时编码时间缩短至160-300毫秒。
AI.motivation: 现有2D高斯泼溅方法在图像重建中需要昂贵的逐图像迭代优化，或依赖手工设计的先验进行基元分配，效率较低，缺乏高效的前馈式解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 逐阶段残差架构：从重建残差中逐步预测额外的高斯基元；2) 显式阶段控制机制：仅在欠重构区域激活新基元；3) 预测-优化-蒸馏（Predict-Optimize-Distill）训练策略：将短视优化后的高斯增量蒸馏回预测器，稳定多阶段预测；4) 联合微调与图像自适应量化器，实现紧凑高斯存储。
AI.result: 在Kodak和DIV2K数据集上，AIR在重建质量上优于代表性高斯基线方法，同时编码时间显著降低至160-300毫秒。
AI.conclusion: AIR成功将高斯拟合过程摊销为单次前向传播，消除了测试时优化需求，在效率与质量之间取得了良好平衡，展示了前馈式高斯泼溅的潜力。

title: LASH: Adaptive Semantic Hybridization for Black-Box Jailbreaking of Large Language Models
summary: Jailbreak attacks expose a persistent gap between the intended safety behavior of aligned large language models and their behavior under adversarial prompting. Existing automated methods are increasingly effective but each commits to a single attack family (e.g., one refinement loop, one tree search, one mutation space, or one strategy library) and no single family dominates: the best-performing method shifts across target models and harm categories, suggesting complementary strengths that per-prompt composition could exploit. We introduce LASH (LLM Adaptive Semantic Hybridization), a black-box framework that treats outputs from multiple base attacks as reusable seed prompts and adaptively composes them for each target request. Given a seed pool, LASH searches over seed subsets and softmax-normalized mixture weights; a composition module synthesizes a single candidate prompt, and a derivative-free genetic optimizer updates the weights using black-box target feedback and a two-stage fitness function combining keyword-based refusal detection with LLM-judge scoring. On JailbreakBench, which contains 100 harmful prompts across 10 categories, we evaluate LASH on six common target models. LASH achieves an average attack success rate of 84.5% under keyword-based evaluation and 74.5% under two-stage evaluation, where responses are first filtered for refusals and then scored by an LLM judge for whether they substantively fulfill the original harmful request. LASH outperforms five state-of-the-art baselines on both metrics with only 30 mean target queries. LASH also remains competitive under three defense mechanisms and induces more success-like internal representations. These results suggest that adaptive composition across heterogeneous jailbreak strategies is a promising direction for black-box red-teaming.

AI.tldr: 提出LASH框架，通过自适应组合多种越狱攻击策略，显著提升了黑盒场景下对大型语言模型的安全测试成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动越狱攻击方法各自局限于单一攻击家族（如单一优化循环、树搜索等），没有一种方法在所有模型和危害类别上占优，说明不同策略具有互补优势，需要一种自适应组合方法。
AI.method: LASH是一个黑盒框架，将多个基础攻击的输出作为可复用种子提示，通过种子子集搜索、softmax归一化混合权重、组合模块合成候选提示，以及基于无导数遗传优化器进行权重更新，采用两阶段适应度函数（关键词拒绝检测+LLM裁判评分）。
AI.result: 在JailbreakBench的100个有害提示、6个目标模型上，LASH关键词评估平均攻击成功率84.5%，两阶段评估74.5%，优于5个SOTA基线，仅需平均30次目标查询，且在三种防御机制下仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 跨异构越狱策略的自适应组合是黑盒红队测试的一个有前景的方向。

title: VSCD: Video-based Scene Change Detection in Unaligned Scenes
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Detecting what has changed in an environment is essential for long-term autonomy, yet most change detection settings assume fixed viewpoints, mild misalignment, or only a few changed objects. We introduce Video-based Scene Change Detection (VSCD), which predicts a pixel-wise change mask for each query frame, given a reference and a query RGB video of the same indoor space recorded at different times under unconstrained camera motion. The two videos are not temporally synchronized, and many object instances may appear or disappear. To study this setting, we build a large-scale benchmark with over 1.1 million frames annotated with pixel-accurate change masks, together with a real-world test set for evaluating transfer beyond simulation. We propose a query-centric multi-reference model that learns temporal matching implicitly from change-mask supervision, aligns candidate reference features to the query via local patch correspondence, and fuses per-candidate change features using frame-level and patch-level confidence before decoding a high-resolution mask once per frame. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance against strong image- and video-based baselines, and we validate its real-world impact by deploying it on a mobile robot for two downstream applications -- visual surveillance and object incremental learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视频场景变化检测（VSCD）任务，在非同步、相机运动自由的双视频中逐像素检测变化，构建百万级基准数据集，并提出基于查询的多参考时序对齐模型，在仿真和真实场景中均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有变化检测方法依赖固定视角或轻微错位，无法处理相机自由运动、时间不同步、多物体出现/消失的复杂真实场景，缺乏大规模基准和有效方法。
AI.method: 提出查询中心的多参考模型，通过变化掩码监督隐式学习时序匹配，利用局部块对应对齐候选参考特征，结合帧级和块级置信度融合每个候选的变化特征，逐帧解码高分辨率掩码。
AI.result: 在超过110万帧标注数据集上训练，超越图像/视频基线方法；在真实机器人上部署，验证了视觉监控和对象增量学习两项下游应用的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 视频场景变化检测可行且有效，所提方法在仿真和真实场景均达SOTA，具备机器人长期自主应用潜力。

title: "I didn't Make the Micro Decisions": Measuring, Inducing, and Exposing Goal-Level AI Contributions in Collaboration
summary: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape how users form, refine, and extend their goals, attributing contributions in human-AI collaboration becomes critical for users calibrating their own reliance and for evaluators assessing AI-assisted work. Yet existing methods focus on final artifacts, missing the process through which goals themselves are jointly shaped. We introduce a goal-level attribution framework, CoTrace, that decomposes explicit goals into verifiable requirements and traces both direct contributions and indirect influences across dialogue turns. Applying CoTrace to 638 real-world collaboration logs, we find that while models account for only 11-26% of goal-shaping contribution, they contribute substantially more on introducing lower-level concrete requirements, and make various kinds of indirect contributions. Through controlled simulations, we show that interaction design choices significantly affect model goal-shaping behavior. In a user study, exposing participants to goal-level analyses shifts their perceived contributions by nearly 2 points on a 5-point scale, revealing systematic miscalibration in how users understand their own AI-assisted work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoTrace框架，将人机协作中的目标贡献分解为可验证的需求，追踪对话中的直接贡献与间接影响。实验发现模型仅占目标塑造贡献的11-26%，但用户暴露于目标级分析后，其感知贡献偏移近2分（5分制），揭示了用户对AI辅助工作的系统性认知失调。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅关注最终产出，忽略了人机协作中目标本身的共同塑造过程，用户难以校准自身依赖程度，评估者也无法客观衡量AI的贡献。
AI.method: 提出CoTrace框架，将显式目标分解为可验证的需求，追踪对话轮次中的直接贡献和间接影响；应用于638个真实协作日志，并进行控制模拟和用户研究。
AI.result: 模型在目标塑造中仅占11-26%的贡献，但在引入低层具体需求方面贡献显著；交互设计选择显著影响模型的目标塑造行为；暴露于目标级分析后用户感知贡献偏移近2分。
AI.conclusion: 用户对AI辅助工作的贡献存在系统性认知失调，目标层面的归因分析有助于校正用户对自身和AI贡献的理解。

title: TERDNet: Transformer Encoder-Recurrent Decoder Network for Scene Change Detection
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2026
summary: In this work, we address the challenge of Scene Change Detection (SCD), where the goal is to identify variations between two images of the same location captured at different times. Existing SCD models often overlook the varying importance of features across layers, employ single-step decoders that confine refinement, and provide limited insight into encoder pretraining strategies. We propose TERDNet, a Transformer Encoder-Recurrent Decoder Network designed to overcome these limitations. TERDNet consists of a transformer-based encoder that extracts multi-level representations, a feature fusion module that integrates correlation volumes with these features, a recurrent 3-gate-GRU decoder that performs iterative refinement, and a combined convolution-interpolation upsampler that restores fine-grained resolution. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks show that TERDNet consistently outperforms prior approaches and produces more accurate and detailed change masks. Ablation studies confirm the benefit of segmentation-based pretraining and the effectiveness of our fusion design. In addition, robustness tests under viewpoint misalignment confirm TERDNet's potential for deployment in real-world robotic systems, where reliable perception is critical. Our code is available at https://github.com/AutoCompSysLab/TERDNet.

AI.tldr: 提出TERDNet网络，通过Transformer编码器、循环3门GRU解码器和融合模块解决场景变化检测中特征重要性不均、解码器单步和预训练策略不明确的问题，在四个公开数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有SCD模型忽视不同层特征的重要性差异，使用单步解码器导致细化不足，且对编码器预训练策略缺乏深入分析。
AI.method: TERDNet包含：1）基于Transformer的编码器提取多级特征；2）特征融合模块整合相关体积与特征；3）循环3门GRU解码器进行迭代细化；4）卷积-插值组合上采样器恢复分辨率。
AI.result: 在四个公开基准上持续优于现有方法，生成更准确详细的变化掩码；消融实验证实分割预训练和融合设计的有效性；视角偏移鲁棒性测试验证了在真实机器人系统中的部署潜力。
AI.conclusion: TERDNet通过多级特征提取、循环解码和融合设计有效提升了场景变化检测性能，分割预训练策略对效果有显著贡献，模型具备实际部署的鲁棒性。

title: Findings of the Fifth Shared Task on Multilingual Coreference Resolution: Expanding Datasets for Long-Range Entities
summary:
This paper describes the fifth edition of the Shared Task on Multilingual Coreference Resolution, held in conjunction with the CODI-CRAC 2026 workshop. Building on previous iterations, the task required participants to develop systems capable of mention identification and identity-based coreference clustering.
  The 2026 edition specifically emphasizes long-range entities, defined as coreferential chains spanning significant distances, across many words and sentences.
  The task expanded its linguistic scope by incorporating five new datasets and two additional languages. These additions leverage version 1.4 of CorefUD, a harmonized multilingual collection comprising 27 datasets in 19 languages.
  In total, ten systems participated, including four LLM-based approaches (three fine-tuned models and one few-shot approach). While traditional systems still maintained their lead, LLMs demonstrated significant potential, suggesting they may soon challenge established approaches in future editions.

AI.tldr: 第五版多语言共指消解共享任务（CODI-CRAC 2026）引入长距离实体评估，新增5个数据集和2种语言，10个系统参赛（含4个LLM方法），传统方法仍领先但LLM潜力巨大。
AI.motivation: 推动多语言共指消解研究，特别是针对长距离实体的挑战，扩大语言覆盖范围，探索LLM在该任务上的能力。
AI.method: 基于CorefUD 1.4统一框架（19种语言27个数据集），新增5个数据集和2种语言，参赛系统需完成指称识别和基于身份共指聚类，包含传统方法和LLM方法（3个微调+1个少样本）。
AI.result: 10个系统参赛，传统系统仍保持领先，但LLM方法（尤其是微调模型）展现出显著潜力，有望在未来挑战传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 多语言共指消解研究在语言覆盖和长距离实体评估上取得进展；LLM方法虽未超越传统方法，但发展势头强劲，有望在后续版本中实现突破。

title: RelWitness: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation with Visual-Geometric Relation Witnesses
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation seeks to describe object instances and their relations with flexible natural-language predicates. The central difficulty is not only vocabulary expansion, but supervision reliability: relation annotations in 3D scene graph datasets are selective, and many valid object-pair relations are unannotated. We propose RelWitness, a framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation from posed RGB-D sequences under incomplete relation supervision. The key concept is a relation witness: a concrete visual-geometric cue that makes a relation observable in the captured scene. Support relations require contact and vertical ordering; containment requires enclosure; proximity requires metric closeness; orientation requires facing direction; and stable relations should persist across views where both objects are visible. RelWitness constructs relation witness records from RGB views, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, role-sensitive text, object-prior null views, and multi-view consistency. A visual-geometric witness verifier assigns unannotated relation candidates to verified missing positives, reliable negatives, or uncertain unlabeled cases. A witness-guided positive-unlabeled objective then learns from incomplete annotations without turning every missing label into a negative. We further introduce witness-consistent decoding and an RGB-D missing-relation audit protocol. Simulated manuscript-planning experiments on 3DSSG/3RScan and ScanNet-derived open-vocabulary splits show the intended behavior: improved unseen-relation recognition, higher witness precision, lower hallucination, and reduced redundant relation phrases. All numerical results are planning values and must be replaced by reproduced measurements before submission

AI.tldr: 提出RelWitness框架，利用视觉-几何线索（关系见证者）解决开放词汇3D场景图生成中关系标注不完整的问题，通过见证者验证和正-无标签学习提升未见关系识别能力。
AI.motivation: 3D场景图中的关系标注具有选择性，大量有效的物体对关系未被标注，导致监督信号不可靠，限制了开放词汇场景图生成的性能。
AI.method: 提出关系见证者（Relation Witness）概念，从RGB视图、深度图、重建3D几何、角色敏感文本等多模态信息中构建见证记录；设计视觉-几何见证验证器对未标注关系进行分类；采用见证引导的正-无标签（Positive-Unlabeled）目标函数进行学习；引入见证一致性解码和RGB-D缺失关系审计协议。
AI.result: 在3DSSG/3RScan和ScanNet数据集上的模拟实验显示：未见关系识别能力提升、见证者精确率提高、幻觉减少、冗余关系短语减少。所有结果为规划值，需在正式提交前替换为复现测量值。
AI.conclusion: RelWitness通过显式建模关系见证者，有效缓解了3D场景图生成中关系标注不完整带来的监督信号偏差问题，为开放词汇场景理解提供了新思路。

title: Post-Hoc Understanding of Metaphor Processing in Decoder-Only Language Models via Conditional Scale Entropy
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ICPR workshop
summary: Metaphor requires a language model to resolve a token whose contextual meaning diverges from its basic literal sense. Understanding how transformer models organize this reinterpretation across depth remains an open problem in mechanistic interpretability. We introduce conditional scale entropy (CSE), a wavelet-derived measure of how broadly transformer computation engages across frequency scales at each layer position. Two theorems establish that CSE is invariant to update magnitude, isolating the structural pattern of updates from their intensity. Using CSE, we find that metaphorical tokens produce significantly higher spectral breadth than literal tokens at contiguous layer positions on every decoder-only architecture tested, from 124M to 20B parameters (GPT-2 family, LLaMA-2 7B, GPT-oss 20B). The effect survives cluster-based permutation correction, recurs in the early-to-mid relative depth range across models, and converges with an independent analysis of 200 naturalistic VUA pairs. Specificity controls further show that the effect is not explained by semantic complexity or by matched propositional content. These results identify multi-scale coordination as a consistent signature of metaphorical language processing in the decoder-only architectures examined, and establish CSE as a principled tool for characterizing cross-depth structure in transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件尺度熵（CSE）来测量Transformer模型在隐喻处理时跨深度层的频谱广度，发现隐喻性token在多个解码器架构中产生比字面token显著更高的谱宽度，且该效应不受更新幅度影响，揭示了多尺度协调是隐喻语言处理的一致特征。
AI.motivation: 理解Transformer模型如何在深度层次上组织隐喻token的语义重新解释，这是一个可解释性领域尚未解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出条件尺度熵（CSE），一种从小波导出的度量方法，用于测量Transformer每层计算在频率尺度上的参与广度，并给出两个定理证明其对更新幅度具有不变性。
AI.result: 在多个解码器架构上（124M到20B参数），隐喻token在连续层上产生比字面token显著更高的谱宽度，该效应在早期到中层的深度范围内一致出现，且不能被语义复杂度或命题内容解释。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度协调是解码器架构处理隐喻语言的一致特征，CSE可作为表征Transformer跨层结构的原理性工具。

title: ArchSIBench: Benchmarking the Architectural Spatial Intelligence of Vision-Language Models
summary: Architectural spatial intelligence, the ability to recognize and infer architectural space, is fundamental to tasks such as robot navigation, embodied interaction, and 3D scene understanding and generation. Although extensive research has evaluated the basic spatial skills of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as relative orientation, distance comparison, and object counting, these tasks cover only the most elementary levels of spatial cognition and largely overlook higher-level cognition of architectural space, including layout understanding, circulation patterns, and functional zoning. In this work, we present ArchSIBench, a Benchmark for Architectural Spatial Intelligence based on the perspectives from architecture, cognitive science, and psychology. ArchSIBench covers five core dimensions: perception, reasoning, navigation, transformation, and configuration, comprising 17 fine-grained subtasks. Through careful manual annotation by experts with architectural backgrounds, we construct 3,000 question-answer pairs to enable comprehensive evaluation of architectural spatial intelligence. Based on ArchSIBench, we evaluate various VLMs and find that the architectural spatial intelligence of most models shows significant differences from human baselines; additionally, models exhibit substantial variability across capability dimensions. Some state-of-the-art models can approach the level of human evaluators without architectural training. However, a clear gap remains compared to human evaluators with architectural training, particularly in spatial transformation and configuration reasoning. We believe that ArchSIBench will provide important insights and systematic resources for measuring and advancing the architectural spatial intelligence of VLMs. The dataset and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ArchSIBench/ArchSIBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ArchSIBench，一个基于建筑学、认知科学和心理学视角的建筑空间智能基准测试，涵盖感知、推理、导航、变换和配置五个核心维度（17个子任务，3000个问答对），用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的建筑空间智能水平。实验发现多数VLM与人类基线存在显著差距，即使最先进的模型在空间变换和配置推理方面仍落后于受过建筑训练的人类评估者。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅评估VLM的基础空间技能（如相对方向、距离比较、物体计数），缺乏对建筑空间高级认知能力（如布局理解、流线模式、功能分区）的系统评估，因此需要构建一个更全面的基准来测量建筑空间智能。
AI.method: 从建筑学、认知科学和心理学视角出发，构建ArchSIBench基准，涵盖感知、推理、导航、变换和配置五大核心维度共17个细粒度子任务；由具备建筑背景的专家进行人工标注，构建3000个问答对。
AI.result: 多数VLM的建筑空间智能与人类基线存在显著差异，且各模型在不同能力维度上表现差异较大。部分最先进模型可接近无建筑训练的人类评估者水平，但与受过建筑训练的人类评估者相比仍有明显差距，尤其在空间变换和配置推理方面。
AI.conclusion: ArchSIBench为测量和推进VLM的建筑空间智能提供了重要见解和系统化资源，有助于推动机器人导航、具身交互和3D场景理解与生成等任务的发展。

title: Quantifying the cross-linguistic effects of syncretism on agreement attraction
summary: Agreement attraction errors, in which a verb erroneously agrees with an intervening noun rather than its grammatical head, are amplified by morphological syncretism in some languages (English, German, Russian) but not others (Turkish, Armenian), a cross-linguistic pattern without a principled account. We use surprisal and attention entropy from large language models as processing proxies to investigate this variation across four languages. LLM-derived measures replicate behavioral findings in English and German (syncretism modulates attraction), align with Turkish null results (no modulation), and partially capture Russian patterns. We discuss further directions for better understanding why syncretism affects agreement attraction differently across languages.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用大语言模型中的惊奇度和注意力熵作为处理代理，探讨了形态学同形现象对一致性吸引错误在不同语言中的不同影响机制。
AI.motivation: 解释为什么形态同形现象在不同语言中对一致性吸引错误的影响存在差异（英语/德语有影响，土耳其语/亚美尼亚语无影响），目前缺乏原则性的理论解释。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型的惊奇度（surprisal）和注意力熵（attention entropy）作为处理代理，跨四种语言（英语、德语、俄语、土耳其语）进行对比分析。
AI.result: LLM指标复现了英语和德语的行为发现（同形调节吸引效应），与土耳其语的零结果一致，并部分捕捉了俄语的模式。
AI.conclusion: LLM-derived measures可以有效模拟跨语言一致性吸引的变异模式，但同形现象如何影响吸引错误的机制仍需进一步研究。

title: USV: Towards Understanding the User-generated Short-form Videos
summary: Several large-scale video datasets have been published these years and have advanced the area of video understanding. However, the newly emerged user-generated short-form videos have rarely been studied. This paper presents USV, the User-generated Short-form Video dataset for high-level semantic video understanding. The dataset contains around 224K videos collected from UGC platforms by label queries without extra manual verification and trimming. Although video understanding has achieved plausible improvement these years, most works focus on instance-level recognition, which is not sufficient for learning the representation of the high-level semantic information of videos. Therefore, we further establish two tasks: topic recognition and video-text retrieval on USV. We propose two unified and effective baseline methods Multi-Modality Fusion Network (MMF-Net) and Video-Text Contrastive Learning (VTCL), to tackle the topic recognition task and video-text retrieval respectively, and carry out comprehensive benchmarks to facilitate future research. Our project page is https://usvdataset.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为USV的用户生成短视频数据集，包含约22.4万个视频，并针对该数据集建立了主题识别和视频-文本检索两个任务，分别提出了MMF-Net和VTCL作为基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视频数据集主要关注实例级识别，难以学习视频高层语义信息，且用户生成的短视频这一新兴领域缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建USV数据集（约22.4万短视频，来自UGC平台标签查询，无需额外人工验证和修剪）；提出MMF-Net用于主题识别，VTCL用于视频-文本检索。
AI.result: 建立了全面的基准测试，为未来研究提供了参考。
AI.conclusion: USV数据集及提出的基线方法有助于推动用户生成短视频的高层语义理解研究。

title: Mem-$π$: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
summary: We present Mem-$π$, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-$π$ uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the downstream agent, to generate context-specific guidance for complex tasks. Conditioned on the current agent context, the model jointly decides when to produce guidance and what guidance to produce. We train it with a decision-content decoupled reinforcement learning (RL) objective, enabling it to abstain when generation would not help and otherwise produce concise, useful guidance. Across diverse agentic benchmarks spanning web navigation, terminal-based tool use, and text-based embodied interaction, Mem-$π$ consistently outperforms retrieval-based and prior RL-optimized memory baselines, achieving over 30% relative improvement on web navigation tasks.

AI.tldr: Mem-$π$ 是一个为LLM智能体设计的自适应记忆框架，通过专用模型按需生成上下文相关的有用指导，而非从外部存储中检索静态记忆。该方法在多项智能体基准测试中显著优于基于检索和先前RL优化的记忆基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强智能体主要依赖基于相似性的检索从情景记忆库或技能库中获取静态条目，但这些条目往往与当前上下文不匹配，导致效果不佳。为此，作者提出按需生成指导而非检索的记忆方法。
AI.method: 使用一个独立于下游智能体的专用语言或视觉-语言模型，根据当前智能体上下文联合决策何时生成指导以及生成何种指导。采用决策-内容解耦的强化学习（RL）目标进行训练，使模型能够在无帮助时放弃生成，在有益时生成简洁有用的指导。
AI.result: 在网页导航、终端工具使用、基于文本的具身交互等多种智能体基准测试中，Mem-$π$ 一致优于基于检索和先前RL优化的记忆基线，在网页导航任务上取得超过30%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: Mem-$π$ 通过按需生成记忆的方式有效解决了传统检索式记忆与上下文不匹配的问题，验证了生成式记忆在提升LLM智能体性能方面的巨大潜力。

title: Leveraging LLMs for Grammar Adaptation: A Study on Metamodel-Grammar Co-Evolution
summary: In model-driven engineering, metamodel evolution leads to the need to adapt corresponding grammars to maintain consistency, which typically requires tedious manual work. Existing rule-based methods can achieve partial automation but have limitations when handling complex grammar scenarios. This paper proposes a Large Language Model-based approach that automatically applies adaptations to new grammars after evolution by learning grammar adaptations from previous versions. We evaluated this approach on six real-world Xtext domain-specific languages, using four DSLs as a training set to develop prompting strategies, two DSLs as a test set for validation, and conducting a longitudinal case study on QVTo. The evaluation used three Large Language Models (Claude Sonnet 4.5, ChatGPT 5.1, Gemini 3) and measured grammar adaptation quality from three dimensions: grammar rule-level adaptation consistency, output similarity, and metamodel conformance. Results show that on the test set, all three LLMs achieved 100% adaptation consistency and output similarity, while the rule-based approach achieved only 84.21% on DOT and 62.50% on Xcore. In the QVTo longitudinal study, the LLM-based approach successfully reused learned adaptations across all three evolution steps without manual grammar editing, while the rule-based approach required manual adjustments in two of three transitions. However, on large-scale grammars (EAST-ADL, 297 rules), LLMs' adaptation consistency was far below 90%. This study demonstrates the advantages of LLM-based approaches in handling complex grammar scenarios, while revealing their limitations in large-scale grammar adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于大语言模型的方法，通过学习历史版本中的语法自适应模式，自动将元模型演化带来的变化应用到对应语法上，在六个Xtext领域特定语言上进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 元模型演化后需要手动调整对应语法，现有基于规则的方法虽能部分自动化，但在处理复杂语法场景时存在局限性。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型，从历史版本中学习语法自适应模式，自动将演化后的自适应应用到新语法上。使用四个DSL作为训练集设计提示策略，两个DSL作为测试集，并对QVTo进行了纵向案例研究，采用三种LLM（Claude Sonnet 4.5, ChatGPT 5.1, Gemini 3）进行评估。
AI.result: 测试集上三种LLM均达到100%的自适应一致性和输出相似度，远高于基于规则的方法（DOT: 84.21%, Xcore: 62.50%）。QVTo纵向研究中LLM方法在三个演化步骤中均无需手动编辑。但在大规模语法（EAST-ADL, 297条规则）上，LLM的自适应一致性远低于90%。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的方法在处理复杂语法场景方面具有优势，但在大规模语法自适应方面仍存在局限性。

title: VISTA: Technical Report for the Ego4D Short-Term Object Interaction Anticipation at EgoVis 2026
comment: The champion solution for the Ego4D Short-Term Object Interaction Anticipation Challenge at the CVPR EgoVis Workshop 2026
summary: We propose VISTA, a V-JEPA Integrated StillFast Temporal Anticipator for the Ego4D Short-Term Object Interaction Anticipation (STA) Challenge at EgoVis 2026. Given an egocentric video timestamp, the task requires anticipating the next human-object interaction, including the future active object's bounding box, noun category, verb category, time-to-contact, and confidence score. VISTA follows a StillFast-style design that combines object-centric spatial detection with short-horizon temporal context. Specifically, a COCO-pretrained Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN detector generates object proposals from the last observed high-resolution frame, while a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 temporal branch extracts clip-level egocentric context from the observed video. The temporal representation is injected into the detection pathway through feature modulation and ROI-level context fusion. The fused proposal features are then passed to multi-head STA predictors for box refinement, noun classification, verb classification, time-to-contact regression, and interaction confidence estimation. For the final submission, we further ensemble complementary predictions to improve robustness. Experimental results on the official challenge server show that VISTA achieves first place in the EgoVis 2026 Ego4D STA Challenge. Our code will be released at https://github.com/CorrineQiu/VISTA.

AI.tldr: VISTA是一种结合V-JEPA时序特征和Faster R-CNN空间检测的StillFast架构，用于Ego4D短期物体交互预测任务，在EgoVis 2026挑战赛中取得第一名。
AI.motivation: 解决Ego4D第一人称视频中下一时刻人-物交互的预测问题，需同时预测交互物体边界框、名词类别、动词类别、接触时间和置信度。
AI.method: 采用StillFast双流设计：1) 空间流使用COCO预训练的Faster R-CNN提取最后一帧高分辨率物体提案；2) 时序流使用冻结的V-JEPA 2.1提取clip级上下文特征，通过特征调制和ROI级融合注入检测通路；3) 融合后经多头预测器输出边界框、名词/动词分类、接触时间回归和置信度；4) 集成多模型提升鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在EgoVis 2026 Ego4D STA挑战赛官方榜单上获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: VISTA验证了冻结的V-JEPA时序特征与空间检测器结合在STA任务上的有效性，集成策略进一步提升了性能。

title: Focus-then-Context: Subject-Centric Progressive Visual Token Reduction for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face a bottleneck of prohibitive computational costs arising from massive visual token sequences during inference. Existing vision token reduction methods alleviate this burden, but they unintentionally preserve the isolated visual subject strictly aligned with the user's query, which fails to substantially explore salient subjects and their contextual relationships. In this paper, we propose SPpruner, a subject-centric progressive reduction paradigm that emulates the \textit{Focus-then-Context} mechanism of the human visual perception system. Specifically, we first construct a focus identification module to explicitly model the interplay between visual saliency and semantic relevance. Herein, it can excavate the comprehensive visual subject spectrum to ensure a high-fidelity representation of visual input. Subsequently, a context-aware structural scanning module is developed to aggregate contextual cues from neighboring regions. As such, it can effectively restore global relational dependencies to uphold the structural integrity of the preserved subjects. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our paradigm consistently outperforms SOTA methods, achieving up to 2.53 times speedup with only 22.2% of visual tokens retained in Qwen2.5-VL and a 67% FLOPs reduction on LLaVA with a negligible 0.6% accuracy drop.

AI.tldr: 提出SPpruner，一种模拟人类视觉"聚焦-上下文"机制的渐进式视觉令牌缩减范式，通过焦点识别模块挖掘完整视觉主题，再通过上下文感知扫描模块聚合邻域线索，在保持高精度（仅下降0.6%）的同时实现高达2.53倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉令牌缩减方法虽减轻了计算负担，但无意中保留了与用户查询严格对齐的孤立视觉主题，未能充分挖掘显著主体及其上下文关系。
AI.method: 首先构建焦点识别模块，显式建模视觉显著性与语义相关性之间的相互作用，挖掘全面的视觉主题谱系；然后开发上下文感知结构扫描模块，从邻域区域聚合上下文线索，恢复全局关系依赖。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL上仅保留22.2%视觉令牌实现2.53倍加速；在LLaVA上减少67% FLOPs，精度仅下降0.6%。
AI.conclusion: SPpruner在视觉令牌缩减任务上持续超越SOTA方法，实现了高效推理与高保真视觉表征的良好平衡。

title: FruitEnsemble: MLLM-Guided Arbitration for Heterogeneous ensemble in Fine-Grained Fruit Recognition
summary: Fine-grained fruit classification is a critical yet challenging task in agricultural computer vision, primarily hindered by a severe shortage of high-quality datasets and the high visual similarity between classes. To address these challenges, we first constructed a comprehensive dataset comprising 306 fruit categories with 116,233 samples. Moreover, we propose FruitEnsemble, a practical two-stage dynamic inference framework designed to overcome the generalization limitations of static single-model architectures. In the first stage, FruitEnsemble employs a validation-calibrated weighted ensemble of heterogeneous backbones to generate a robust Top-3 candidate pool. To tackle difficult samples, we introduce an expert arbitration mechanism: when ensemble confidence falls below 0.6, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) is triggered to perform rigorous visual verification by integrating external botanical descriptions using Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. Furthermore, we optimized the training pipeline with a hard sample-aware joint loss. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FruitEnsemble achieves a classification accuracy of 70.49\% and outperforms existing state-of-the-art models. Our framework provides an efficient, deployment-oriented solution for real-world agricultural visual sorting and quality inspection tasks.

AI.tldr: 针对细粒度水果分类中数据集稀缺和类间相似度高的问题，构建了包含306类116,233样本的数据集，并提出FruitEnsemble两阶段动态推理框架：第一阶段通过验证校准的异构骨干网络加权集成生成Top-3候选池；第二阶段在置信度低于0.6时触发多模态大模型，结合外部植物学描述和CoT推理进行验证。优化了难样本感知联合损失，最终达到70.49%的分类准确率，超越现有最先进模型。
AI.motivation: 细粒度水果分类面临高质量数据集严重不足以及不同类别间视觉高度相似两大挑战，导致静态单模型架构的泛化能力受限。
AI.method: FruitEnsemble两阶段动态推理框架：1) 验证校准的异构骨干网络加权集成生成Top-3候选池；2) 当集成置信度低于0.6时，触发多模态大语言模型结合外部植物学描述和CoT推理进行视觉验证。同时采用难样本感知的联合损失优化训练流程。
AI.result: 在306类116,233样本的数据集上达到70.49%的分类准确率，超越现有最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为真实农业视觉分拣和质量检测任务提供了高效、可部署的解决方案。

title: Finding the Correct Visual Evidence Without Forgetting: Mitigating Hallucination in LVLMs via Inter-Layer Visual Attention Discrepancy
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown remarkable performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks. Despite this progress, they are still prone to hallucination, generating responses that are inconsistent with visual content. In this work, we find that LVLMs tend to hallucinate when they pay insufficient attention to the correct visual evidence and gradually forget it during the generation process. We empirically find that although LVLMs overall attend insufficiently to visual evidence, they exhibit sensitivity to the correct visual evidence in specific layers, with notable inter-layer discrepancy. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel hallucination mitigation method that enhances visual evidence based on Inter-Layer Visual Attention Discrepancy (ILVAD). Specifically, we obtain the attention weights from early generated tokens to visual tokens across layers and identify the tokens that are repeatedly activated as visual evidence, forming a saliency map. We then enhance attention to visual evidence during generation through the saliency map to reduce visual forgetting. In addition, we leverage the saliency map to obtain attention scores of generated text to visual evidence, in order to select and emphasize text tokens that are strongly grounded in visual evidence. Our method is training-free and plug-and-play. Multiple benchmark evaluations conducted on five recently released models show that our method can consistently mitigate hallucinations in different LVLMs over various architectures. Code is available at https://github.com/ytx-ML/ILVAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于层间视觉注意力差异（ILVAD）的无训练、即插即用方法，通过增强视觉证据注意力与筛选视觉关联文本token，有效缓解LVLM的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: LVLM在生成时对正确视觉证据关注不足且逐渐遗忘，导致幻觉问题。现有方法存在局限性，需要一种训练-free、可通用的缓解方案。
AI.method: 1) 利用早期生成token对各层视觉token的注意力权重，识别反复激活的token构建显著性图。2) 通过显著性图增强生成时对视觉证据的注意力以减少视觉遗忘。3) 利用显著性图筛选与视觉证据强关联的文本token并增强其注意力分数。
AI.result: 在5个近期发布的LVLM模型上，多个基准评估表明该方法能持续、有效地缓解不同架构LVLM的幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: ILVAD是一种无训练、即插即用的幻觉缓解方法，通过利用层间视觉注意力差异增强视觉证据关注，有效提升了LVLM生成的真实性。

title: Comparative Evaluation of Deep Learning Models for Fake Image Detection
comment: Accepted at ICCIIoT26 and waiting to be indexed
summary: The growing sophistication of GAN-based image manipulation presents significant challenges for digital forensics. This study compares the performance of four pretrained CNN architectures including VGG16, ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, and XceptionNet for fake image detection using a unified preprocessing and training pipeline. A dataset of real and manipulated images was processed through resizing, normalization, and augmentation to address class imbalance and improve generalization. Models were evaluated using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC. VGG16 achieved the highest accuracy at 91%, with XceptionNet, ResNet50, and EfficientNetB0 each reaching 90%. EfficientNetB0 showed stronger sensitivity to fake images but reduced reliability on real samples, reflecting imbalance-driven bias. Limitations include dataset imbalance, overfitting, and limited interpretability, which affect cross-domain robustness. The study provides a reproducible baseline and underscores the need for balanced datasets, advanced augmentation, and fairness-aware training to develop reliable fake image detection systems.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种预训练CNN架构（VGG16、ResNet50、EfficientNetB0、XceptionNet）在GAN生成图像检测中的表现。在统一预处理和训练流程下，VGG16以91%的准确率最高，其余模型均达90%。研究揭示了数据不平衡导致的偏差问题，并强调需要平衡数据集、先进数据增强和公平性训练来构建可靠的假图检测系统。
AI.motivation: 基于GAN的图像篡改技术日益复杂，对数字取证构成了严峻挑战，迫切需要有效的假图检测方法。
AI.method: 采用统一预处理和训练流程，对四种预训练CNN架构（VGG16、ResNet50、EfficientNetB0、XceptionNet）进行比较，使用包含真实和篡改图像的数据集，经过调整大小、归一化和数据增强处理，以Accuracy、Precision、Recall、F1-score和ROC-AUC为评价指标。
AI.result: VGG16准确率最高达91%，XceptionNet、ResNet50和EfficientNetB0均达90%。EfficientNetB0对假图更敏感但识别真实样本可靠性下降，存在不平衡偏差。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了可复现的基线结果，指出数据集不平衡、过拟合和可解释性有限是影响跨域鲁棒性的主要限制，未来需要平衡数据集、先进增强技术和公平性感知训练。

title: JFAA: Technical Report for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Anticipation Challenge at EgoVis 2026
comment: The champion solution for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Action Anticipation Challenge at the CVPR EgoVis Workshop 2026
summary: We propose JFAA, a JEPA-based Future Action Anticipation method for the EPIC-KITCHENS-100 (EK-100) Action Anticipation task. Inspired by the representation learning and future prediction ability of V-JEPA 2.1, JFAA uses a frozen encoder and predictor to extract observed context features and near-future latent tokens. A lightweight attentive probe is then trained to predict verb, noun, and action logits with separate task queries. To improve robustness, we further build a field-aware ensemble over selected epoch-level predictions, allowing each output field to benefit from its most reliable candidates. Experimental results on the official challenge server show that JFAA achieves first place in the EgoVis 2026 EK-100 Action Anticipation Challenge. Our code will be released at https://github.com/CorrineQiu/JFAA.

AI.tldr: JFAA是一种基于JEPA的未来动作预测方法，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作预测任务中取得了第一名。
AI.motivation: 受V-JEPA 2.1的表示学习和未来预测能力的启发，旨在提升第一人称视频中未来动作预测的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用冻结的编码器和预测器提取观察上下文特征和近未来潜在token，使用轻量级注意力探针通过独立任务查询预测动词、名词和动作logits，并构建场感知集成策略选择最优epoch级预测结果。
AI.result: 在EgoVis 2026 EK-100动作预测挑战赛官方排行榜上获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: JFAA在EK-100动作预测任务上表现优越，代码将开源。

title: SynCB: A Synergy Concept-Based Model with Dynamic Routing Between Concepts and Complementary Neural Branches
summary: Concept-based (CB) models provide interpretability and support test-time human intervention, while standard neural networks (NN) offer strong task performance but little transparency. Prior work has explored hybrid formulations that integrate concepts and additional representations to improve accuracy, often at the cost of human interventions. We introduce the \emph{Synergy Concept-Based Model (SynCB)} framework, that combines a CB branch with a complementary neural branch, and a trainable routing module that dynamically selects which branch to use for each input. Unlike prior models, which fuse residual and concept-based predictions, SynCB keeps the two branches distinct and coordinates them through the routing module. Moreover, both branches are learned jointly, allowing information sharing between the complementary neural branch and CB branches through their common backbone. To improve responsiveness to interventions, we further introduce a test-time intervention policy and a corresponding loss. Across five datasets and CB benchmarks, SynCB consistently achieves higher task accuracy while remaining more responsive to human interventions, surpassing the full neural baseline by up to 3.9 percentage points and exceeding the strongest competitor in intervention performance by up to 6.43 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出SynCB框架，通过动态路由模块协调概念分支和神经分支，在保持可解释性和干预能力的同时提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有概念模型虽具可解释性和干预能力但准确率不足，而标准神经网络性能强但缺乏透明度；混合模型常以牺牲人类干预能力为代价提升准确率。
AI.method: SynCB包含概念分支、互补神经分支和可训练路由模块，动态为每个输入选择分支；通过共享骨干网络实现信息共享，并引入测试时干预策略及对应损失函数。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上，SynCB任务准确率超过全神经网络基线最多3.9个百分点，干预性能超过最强基线最多6.43个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SynCB通过保持分支独立与动态路由机制，实现了任务性能与干预响应性的双赢，优于现有混合模型。

title: Hybrid Machine Learning Model for Forest Height Estimation from TanDEM-X and Landsat Data
summary: Integrating machine learning (ML) with physical models (PM) has emerged as a promising way of retrieving geophysical parameters from remote sensing data. In this context, a ML model for estimating forest height from TanDEM-X interferometric coherence measurements has recently been proposed, that constrains the learning process through a PM. While the features used for training and inversion where selected to ensure the physical consistency of the solutions, they could not resolve all height / structure and baseline / terrain slope ambiguities in the data. To improve this, the extension of the feature space with optical Landsat data is proposed able to provide complementary information on forest type or structure. The extended model is applied and validated on several TanDEM-X acquisitions over the Gabonese Lopé national park site and assessed against airborne LiDAR measurements. Results show a 13.5% reduction in RMSE and a 16.6% reduction in MAE compared to the original hybrid model, confirming the added value of multispectral inputs.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过将光学Landsat数据与TanDEM-X干涉测量相结合，扩展了混合机器学习-物理模型的特征空间，用于森林高度反演，在加蓬Lopé国家公园的验证中，RMSE降低13.5%，MAE降低16.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有的混合机器学习-物理模型在利用TanDEM-X干涉相干性测量估算森林高度时，由于特征空间的局限性，无法完全解决高度/结构与基线/地形坡度之间的歧义问题，因此需要引入补充信息来改进模型。
AI.method: 将光学Landsat数据（提供森林类型或结构的补充信息）引入原有混合模型的特征空间，扩展后的模型应用于加蓬Lopé国家公园的多期TanDEM-X数据，并以机载LiDAR测量作为验证基准。
AI.result: 与原始混合模型相比，扩展后的模型RMSE降低13.5%，MAE降低16.6%，证实了多光谱输入对森林高度估算的增值效果。
AI.conclusion: 引入光学遥感数据的多光谱信息能够有效提升混合模型对森林高度的反演精度，为未来遥感参数反演的多源数据融合提供了可行思路。

title: FlowLong: Inference-time Long Video Generation via Manifold-constrained Tweedie Matching
summary: Extending the generation horizon of video diffusion models to long sequences remains a long-standing and important challenge. Existing training-free approaches fall into two categories: extensions of bidirectional models, which are tightly coupled to specific architectures and suffer from quality degradation over long horizons, and autoregressive models, which accumulate drift errors due to exposure bias and tend to produce repetitive motion patterns. To address these issues, we propose a novel but simple inference-time approach for long video generation that is architecture-agnostic and requires no additional training. Our method generates long videos via overlapping sliding windows, where predicted clean samples from adjacent windows are blended via \emph{Tweedie matching} to enforce both \textbf{manifold constraint and temporal consistency} across overlap regions. \emph{Stochastic early-phase sampling} then synchronizes per-window trajectories by injecting fresh noise after each Tweedie matching correction in the high-noise phase, before transitioning to deterministic ODE sampling to preserve fine-grained visual fidelity. Applied to various video generation models, our method generates videos several times longer than the native window length while outperforming both training-free and autoregressive baselines in temporal consistency and visual quality, and further extends to audio-video joint generation and text-to-3DGS without any fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Tweedie Matching + Stochastic Early-Phase Sampling的推理时方法，通过滑动窗口与噪声注入实现长视频生成，无需额外训练，可适用于多种视频生成架构。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练方法（双向模型扩展与自回归模型）在生成长视频时分别存在架构耦合、质量退化、误差累积和运动模式重复等问题。
AI.method: 采用重叠滑动窗口生成相邻片段，通过Tweedie匹配（Tweedie matching）混合相邻窗口的预测干净样本，以同时保证流形约束和时间一致性；在高噪声阶段注入新鲜噪声实现随机早期采样（stochastic early-phase sampling），同步各窗口轨迹，随后转为确定性ODE采样以保持视觉保真度。
AI.result: 在多种视频生成模型上实现数倍于原始窗口长度的长视频生成，在时间一致性和视觉质量上优于现有免训练和自回归基线，并零微调扩展到音视频联合生成和文本到3DGS生成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法是一种架构无关、无需额外训练的推理时方案，有效解决了长视频生成中的质量退化与误差累积问题，具有良好的通用性和扩展性。

title: RISE: Reliable Improvement in Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, but further improving them still relies heavily on large-scale human-constructed supervision for post-training. Such supervision is costly to obtain, especially for reasoning-intensive multimodal tasks where questions, answers, and feedback signals must be carefully designed. This motivates self-evolving learning, where a model improves itself through a dual-role closed loop: a questioner autonomously poses questions and a solver learns to solve them. However, we observe that current VLM self-evolving methods still face three major challenges: coarse-grained role alternation delays the interaction between question generation and solver adaptation; generated questions can progressively degrade in quality; and question types may collapse toward a narrow distribution. These issues limit the efficiency and reliability of self-evolution. Thus, we propose \textbf{RISE}, a reliable self-evolving framework for vision-language models. RISE is built on three complementary designs: fine-grained role alternation, which shortens the feedback loop between the questioner and the solver to improve efficiency; a quality supervisor, which improves question validity and pseudo-label reliability; and skill-aware dynamic balancing, which mitigates mode collapse and maintains broad skill coverage during evolution. Together, these components enable more reliable and effective self-evolution from unlabeled images. Experiments on two VLM backbones across seven benchmarks show that RISE consistently improves the base models, yielding broad and sustained gains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/RISE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RISE框架，通过细粒度角色交替、质量监督器和技能感知动态平衡三个设计，实现了视觉语言模型在无标注图像上的可靠自我进化，在多个基准测试中持续提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM自我进化方法存在三个问题：(1)粗粒度角色交替导致问题生成与求解器适应之间的交互延迟；(2)生成的问题质量逐渐下降；(3)问题类型可能坍缩到狭窄分布。这些问题限制了自我进化的效率和可靠性。
AI.method: RISE包含三个互补设计：(1)细粒度角色交替——缩短提问者与求解器之间的反馈循环以提高效率；(2)质量监督器——提升问题的有效性和伪标签的可靠性；(3)技能感知动态平衡——缓解模式坍缩，在进化过程中保持广泛的技能覆盖。
AI.result: 在两个VLM骨干网络和七个基准测试上的实验表明，RISE能够持续改进基础模型，取得广泛且持续的增益。
AI.conclusion: RISE通过三个互补设计实现了更可靠、更有效的视觉语言模型自我进化，代码已开源。

title: DySink: Dynamic Frame Sinks for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive long video generation often adopts bounded-memory streaming for efficiency, typically combining local windows for short-term continuity with static early-frame sinks as long-range anchors. However, this fixed allocation keeps early frames cached even when the current visual state has substantially diverged from them, while discarding potentially more relevant intermediate history. As a result, the retained long-range context may become less adaptive and bias generation toward outdated cues; in severe cases, RoPE-induced phase re-alignment can homogenize inter-head attention and cause sink collapse, where content regresses toward sink frames. We propose DySink, a retrieval-based framework that maintains a compact memory bank and selects visually relevant historical frames as dynamic frame sinks. DySink couples adaptive retrieval with a sink anomaly gate, which detects excessive inter-head consensus over retrieved context and suppresses collapse-prone context. Experiments on minute-long videos show that DySink consistently improves dynamic degree over strong baselines while also achieving higher temporal quality. The code and model weights will be released at https://github.com/yebo0216best/DySink.

AI.tldr: DySink提出了一种基于检索的动态帧汇聚机制，替代传统静态早期帧缓存，通过维护紧凑记忆库并选择视觉相关的历史帧作为动态锚点，配合汇聚异常门控检测并抑制注意力坍塌，有效提升长视频生成中的动态性和时间质量。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归长视频生成采用固定内存分配（局部窗口+静态早期帧缓存），导致早期帧在视觉状态大幅变化后仍被保留，造成长程上下文僵化、偏向过时线索，甚至引发RoPE相位重对齐导致注意力坍塌和内容退化，亟需更灵活的长程上下文管理机制。
AI.method: 提出DySink框架：1）维护紧凑记忆库，检索视觉相关的历史帧作为动态帧汇聚（dynamic frame sinks）；2）设计汇聚异常门控（sink anomaly gate），检测跨注意力头的一致性异常，主动抑制易坍塌的上下文。
AI.result: 在分钟级长视频生成实验中，DySink在动态性指标上持续优于强基线方法，同时获得了更高的时间质量。
AI.conclusion: 动态检索式帧汇聚与异常检测门控能有效替代静态缓存策略，在长视频生成中兼顾长程依赖保持与注意力健康，为长视频高效生成提供了新思路。

title: PaintCopilot: Modeling Painting as Autonomous Artistic Continuation
summary:
We present PaintCopilot, a co-creative neural painting assistant that models painting as an open-ended autoregressive artistic behavior conditioned on evolving canvas states and prior brushstroke history, without requiring a target image. Unlike existing neural painting methods that frame painting as pixel reconstruction toward a predefined reference, PaintCopilot predicts future strokes directly from learned artistic dynamics, analogous to how large language models continue text sequences from prior context.
  The framework proposes three complementary models: a ViT-based Target Predictor that infers artist intent from partial canvas observations, an autoregressive Next Stroke Predictor that generates temporally coherent brushstrokes via flow matching, and a VAE-based Region Sampler that synthesizes semantically localized stroke sequences on demand. Built on three differentiable brush representations (Hard Round, Brush Tip, and 2D Gaussian), the system supports four interactive workflows: Optimize History, Stroke Completion, Region Inpainting, and Dynamic Brush. Through case studies with professional artists, we demonstrate that PaintCopilot enables fluid co-creative painting workflows in which artists and AI continuously alternate control throughout the creative process.

AI.tldr: PaintCopilot 是一个协同创作的神经绘画助手，将绘画建模为基于画布状态和历史笔触的自回归艺术行为，无需目标图像，通过三个互补模型（目标预测器、下一笔触预测器、区域采样器）和四种交互工作流实现人与AI的持续交替控制。
AI.motivation: 现有神经绘画方法将绘画视为对预定义参考图像的像素重建，限制了创作自由度。作者希望突破这一局限，让AI像大语言模型续写文本一样，基于已有画布状态和笔触历史预测未来笔触，实现真正的协同创作。
AI.method: 提出三个互补模型：1) ViT-based Target Predictor 从部分画布推断艺术家意图；2) 自回归 Next Stroke Predictor 通过流匹配生成时序连贯的笔触；3) VAE-based Region Sampler 合成语义化的局部笔触序列。系统基于三种可微笔刷表示，支持四种交互工作流。
AI.result: 通过与专业艺术家的案例研究，证明PaintCopilot能够实现流畅的协同创作工作流，艺术家和AI可以在创作过程中持续交替控制。
AI.conclusion: PaintCopilot成功将绘画从像素重建任务转变为开放式的自回归艺术行为生成，为AI辅助创意绘画提供了新的范式。

title: Grounding Driving VLA via Inverse Kinematics
